question: Which Linux companion app architecture should OpenClaw support before either open Linux implementation becomes mergeable?
rationale: The remaining work is not a one-file fix: maintainers must choose between overlapping large C/GTK and Rust/GTK implementations, security posture, packaging ownership, and proof requirements.

options.title: Choose a primary Linux track
options.body: Select one Linux companion architecture to review toward merge, then close, adopt, or redirect the other tracks around that decision.

options.title: Defer app merge and split gaps
options.body: Keep this umbrella open but only land narrower Linux gaps such as notification or node-host support until app ownership is clearer.

options.title: Re-scope after Windows Hub
options.body: Split the remaining work into a Linux-only tracker and separate Windows Hub parity bugs, preserving this discussion as context.

recommendation.title: Choose a primary Linux track
recommendation.body: Select one Linux companion architecture to review toward merge, then close, adopt, or redirect the other tracks around that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the tracker, supplied the GTK-native Linux product direction, and is the strongest available owner signal for the architecture choice.
